# telnyx_ai_collection (Data Source)

A knowledge collection that AI assistants search, filled from storage buckets, calls, meetings and messages.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `name` (String) Human-readable collection name.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the record type. Always `ai_collection`.
- `retrieval` (Attributes) How documents are retrieved when searching the collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retrieval))
- `slug` (String) Optional slug (unique per organization). Derived from `name` when omitted.
- `sources` (Attributes List) Optional sources to attach at creation time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--retrieval"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retrieval`

Read-Only:

- `retrieval_type` (String) Retrieval strategy. `vector` runs semantic similarity search; `hybrid` combines vector similarity with keyword matching; `keyword` runs lexical (BM25) matching. `keyword` is not accepted yet: setting it returns 422 `unsupported_retrieval_type`. A collection set to `hybrid` is accepted here but cannot be searched until hybrid execution ships. One of `hybrid`, `vector`.
- `top_k` (Number) Number of top results to retrieve (1–50).


<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_id` (String) The Telnyx Storage bucket name. Present only for `bucket` sources.
- `collection_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the record type. Always `ai_collection_source`.
- `source_type` (String) The type of Telnyx data attached as a source. `bucket` requires an additional `bucket_id`. Only `voice` is searchable today; `meeting_bot`, `message`, and `bucket` attach but are not yet searchable (Coming soon). One of `bucket`, `meeting_bot`, `message`, `voice`.
- `status` (String)
